groups.label: Minibuses
groups.source: chosen: calm green. The soi minibuses and songthaews have no operator brand; OTP's City Mini Bus colour 20B2AA would draw #53d5cd, 0.040 from the city line. Source step: trail #6dd982, line #299446.

groups.label: Boats
groups.source: chosen: FFCC00 is namtang's route_color on the Chao Phraya Express yellow flag (183, 2715), 1 boat at 08:01. Most boats then are the Saen Saep boats (74 of 151, CC00CC, the vans' magenta) and the cross-river ferries (35, 0000FF), so no single brand stands for them. Source step: trail #e6b800, line #997900.
